task.title: Configure home, search, and navigation
task.shortdesc: Set home surfaces, navigation behavior, managed search engines, and search suggestions from Step 2.

prereq.p: Step 2 is open and the schema channel is correct.

context.p: These controls affect what users see first and how Firefox resolves navigation and search activity.

step.cmd: Open the home, search, and navigation sections.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Set homepage or new-tab behavior required by the profile.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Configure managed search engines and search suggestions according to policy.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Review navigation defaults before moving to security settings.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The profile defines home, managed search, suggestions, and navigation behavior.

postreq.p: Recovery: if users would lose an expected search path, adjust the managed search engine entry before saving.
